headline: Dubai gold prices drop to lowest level of 2026 on US rate hike expectations
summary: Gold prices in Dubai dropped to their lowest levels of 2026 as market participants priced in persistent energy-driven inflation and potential further US Federal Reserve monetary tightening.
why: Dubai is a major physical bullion trading hub; bullion demand softens when elevated real interest rates increase the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding metals.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Expectations of prolonged central bank interest rate tightness pushed Dubai bullion to yearly lows.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Bets on persistent inflation driving further US Federal Reserve tightening weighed on physical gold prices.
